subject: Subsetting in list of list - different behaviour in the console and in shinyapp?

messages.author: a417fa537bba98f2
messages.subject: Subsetting in list of list - different behaviour in the console and in shinyapp?
parts:
Dear All,

I am trying to display shapes in a leaflet app according to datatable selections.

The selection part works fine but I then want to display different types of shapes (i.e, lines, polygons, points). I therefore need to get three subsets of said selection as each will be routed to a different function (addCircleMarkers, addLines, addPolygons).

The kind of data I want to subset from:

     label type nodes
[1,] "aa"  "2"  List,3
[2,] "b"   "1"  List,3
[3,] "bb"  "2"  List,3

 or:

selected <-
structure(list("aa", "b", "bb", "2", "1", "2", structure(list(
    lng = c(-1.68213129043579, -1.68131589889526, -1.68326854705811,
    -1.68213129043579), lat = c(48.3060912668542, 48.3040359722955,
    48.3020519636277, 48.3060912668542), layerId = c("3", "4",
    "5", "3")), .Names = c("lng", "lat", "layerId"), row.names = c(NA,
4L), class = "data.frame"), structure(list(lng = c(-1.67867660522461,
-1.67867660522461), lat = c(48.3074614172468, 48.3074614172468
), layerId = c("10", "proto")), .Names = c("lng", "lat", "layerId"
), row.names = 1:2, class = "data.frame"), structure(list(lng = c(-1.68155193328857,
-1.68088674545288, -1.68155193328857), lat = c(48.3060341764562,
48.3038932404334, 48.3060341764562), layerId = c("11", "12",
"11")), .Names = c("lng", "lat", "layerId"), row.names = c(NA,
3L), class = "data.frame")), .Dim = c(3L, 3L), .Dimnames = list(
    NULL, c("label", "type", "nodes")))

in the console I can do this:

lines<-selected[selected[,2]=='2',] or selected[selected[,2]=='2',][,3] ifI just want the coordinates.
lines
     label type nodes
[1,] "aa"  "2"  List,3
[2,] "bb"  "2"  List,3

But when running the same thing from server.R I get:

Warning: Error in [: nombre de dimensions incorrect

I am probably terrible at subsetting but I can't figure out why this wouldn't work in my app while I have no trouble with the console.

At first I had tried storing my geographic entities as Spatial-class objects and thought the error was essentially due to me getting more confused around S4 objects but I am not so sure it is my actual problem now.

The loaded libraries are:

library(shiny)
library(shinyjs)
library(leaflet)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(shinyAce)
library(sp)


Your thoughts are most welcome,

Best regards,

Bastien

messages.author: a417fa537bba98f2
messages.subject: Re: Subsetting in list of list - different behaviour in the console and in shinyapp?
parts:
UPDATE:

I have been able to replicate my problem in the console, it occurs when there is only one entry in my dataset: nothing to do with shiny, it is indeed my subsetting skills.

Sorry for the trouble,

Bastien
